title: Ticket Hygiene: choose the visual world
question: Your brief pins minimal, glass, blur and a dark/light switch. The roll assigned Long Exposure. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Long Exposure
options.lineage: Night-shift city light trails, photographed through a frosted window
options.thesis: The notifier's live traffic seen through frosted glass: every check a passing light, every alert a red tail-light.
materials: bokeh light field drawn from live data
options.viewport: Left rail nav; a full-width live river of the last hour's checks as blurred lights behind glass; below it three glass panes: your team's unreviewed alerts, rules with counts, notifier health; theme switch top right.
options.risk: The lights must always be real data, and their motion calm enough to work beside, or it turns into wallpaper.

raised.raise: Red is reserved for alerts alone, the way the terminal's yellow is reserved for wayfinding: nothing decorative ever uses it.
One family, one voice: a single grotesk for everything, its mono cut only for ticket numbers, IDs and times.
The feed's sticky head names the span in view (09:41-10:12 UTC, 38 checks), recomputed as you scroll.
Review queue: the next unreviewed alert is one keypress away and already loaded.
Verdicts stamp onto the alert and stay; a changed verdict strikes through the old one, nothing is deleted.

options.label: Third Umpire
options.lineage: Cricket broadcast DRS reviews and translucent score graphics
options.thesis: Each alert is an on-field call, the associate is the third umpire, and the model's score is ball-tracking with an umpire's-call zone.
options.viewport: Score strip of today's alerts by rule; centre, the alert under review with its 0-100% tracking bar and the 40-60% umpire's-call band shaded, Upheld / Overturned; right, ball-by-ball live feed.
options.risk: Sports-broadcast graphics are a familiar dashboard trope, and cricket wording could feel flippant about people's work: keep the words plain.

options.label: Concourse Board
options.thesis: Checks are departures: ranked by due time, columns fixed, rows flip as their status changes.
materials: matte flap faces translated to frosted cells
brushed steel frame as glass edge
options.viewport: The live board leads: due checks as rows with rule, ticket, engineer, due-in, status; flagged rows lamp red; detail opens as a glass pane over the board.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for the live view (it holds product clarity) but its matte flaps fight the pinned glass and minimal brief, and a board makes every view the feed.
options.risk: Per-character cascades get noisy when 40 checks land in a minute.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Every screen is a junction showing only the next decision.
options.viewport: One yellow band per decision: next unreviewed alert, then the next.
options.case: Fuses poorly: saturated yellow overrides the pinned minimal glass, and a monitoring screen isn't a corridor.
options.kept: One colour reserved for one job only (red, alerts).
options.risk: Shouts on a screen kept open all shift.

options.label: Annual Plate Section
options.lineage: Design annual plates with registration marks
options.thesis: Each alert as a registered plate on near-white stock.
options.viewport: A sheet of alert plates with credit rows.
options.case: Fuses poorly: associates don't identify with print annuals, and it has no night mode of its own.
options.kept: One grotesk for display and caption alike; mono only for labels.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio, not a working tool.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder
options.thesis: Entries ranked by apparatus, guide words naming the span in view.
options.viewport: Dense columns of checks with a guide-word head.
options.case: Fuses poorly on audience and on the pinned glass; strong only as a reading discipline.
options.kept: Guide words: the head names the first and last item in view.
options.risk: Cream and serif is the default it would collapse into.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One alert owns the screen; the next is one flick away.
options.viewport: A single alert full-screen with an action rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: monitoring and team review need many items in view; holds only for the review queue.
options.kept: The next unreviewed alert preloaded, one keypress away.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each alert a coupon that gets stamped, never torn out.
options.viewport: Alert coupons in a wallet, one leg per sheet.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nostalgic paper fights glass, and coupons fit one alert, not a live system.
options.kept: States stamp on and stay; nothing disappears, it cancels.
options.risk: Costume of paper on a live screen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark glassmorphism ops dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, a row of four KPI cards, a line chart, and a recent-alerts table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every admin template by design.
